prompt_text: What is the best Airbnb or short term rental to book in Nashville for a family of four?
engine_stated_criteria: dates, budget per night, and whether you’ll have a car
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one “best” rental without your dates and budget—availability and total price can change a lot. For a family of four, I’d start with a **well-reviewed two-bedroom, two-bath rental in Germantown or East Nashville**: you’ll generally get more space and a calmer neighborhood than right on Broadway. Choose **SoBro or downtown** if being able to walk to attractions matters more than quiet.

A few good starting points:
- **Airbnb’s family-friendly Nashville listings:** https://www.airbnb.com/nashville-tn/stays/family-friendly  
- **Vrbo’s family rentals:** https://www.vrbo.com/vacation-rentals/family/usa/tennessee/middle/nashville  
- **Sentral Sobro** is worth comparing if you want an apartment-style stay near Broadway and Music City Center.

Before booking, check the **total price including fees**, exact bed setup, parking, noise reviews, and whether the listing is legally permitted for short-term stays. If you share your **dates, budget per night, and whether you’ll have a car**, I can narrow down what to look for.
